structural_review.notes: Triangle mode, valid GLB length, UVs and embedded 1024px base colour checked. Requested targets are approximate; actual triangle count and target deviations are reported separately, within the user-specified 3000-prop / 8000-character ceilings. Scale, pivot, topology and visual quality require separate review.

visual_review.notes: Rejected collapsed generated roof after backing-only attempt still left broken overhead silhouette. Preserved cream walls, dark flush front door and footprint; rebuilt only roof-zone triangles as regular six-column, three-row terracotta relief tiles on both pitches, closed underlay and ridge caps. Final actual GLB checked three-quarter, front, rear and top: no white/interior roof holes, intact closed rear wall, +Z door facade, Y3.5m grounded uniform import. Original painted material/1024 albedo retained without new maps. Authored roof is more regular and flatter-faced than original concept tiles; native rendering/device performance not qualified.

import_review.notes: Real scene vertices and indices decoded; finite positions/UVs; retained embedded 1024px base colour. Uniform root transform; raw file preserved.

geometry_repair.description: Removed only the failed roof-zone triangles and rebuilt a regular relief tile roof over two closed pitched backing slabs; original cream walls, door and footprint preserved. Reused existing terracotta paint atlas; one material primitive.
geometry_repair.material_policy: Original embedded base-colour and material retained; no PBR maps, no retexture.
